searches.reason: Develop paired intervention probes that distinguish useful recent intent from broad historical similarity. Measure ranking changes after removing recent, repeated, or isolated interactions, with length-matched controls and uncertainty estimates; connect observed sensitivity to sequence encoding and training signals without claiming causal identification from observational histories.

searches.reason: Turn qualitative feedback into evidence-grounded failure probes: unsupported prerequisites, potentially satisfied durable needs, and weak specific-interest matches. Use only histories, timestamps, titles, and descriptions; preserve unknown judgments separately from explicit mismatches. Seek annotation agreement and calibration methods before interpreting these proxies as immediate-choice acceptance.

searches.reason: Establish whether inexpensive training diagnostics predict real ranking failures. Investigate popularity-stratified hard negatives, sampled-versus-full-catalog rank disagreement, and scale-invariant score diagnostics. Validate usefulness against the fixed macro validation HR@10 across all four datasets, with uncertainty and controls for repeated adaptive selection; keep the host evaluator unchanged.
